inputs.prompt: Redraw the editable source image1 as traditional hand-drawn Japanese gothic fantasy anime, matching ONLY the drawing style of image2: confident clean dark ink contours, flat matte skin colors, hard-edged two-tone cel shadows, broad connected anime hair locks with simple highlight bands, graphic fabric folds and hand-drawn embroidery. Painted gouache background, consistent line weight and selective detail. Preserve source character identity, costume and story unless the specific correction says otherwise. No glossy 3D, plastic skin, realistic single hair strands, photorealistic cloth, PBR metal, CGI, excessive bloom, depth-of-field blur, text or captions. Blue moonlit cathedral, restrained amber candles. Recompose the source as a medium shot from slightly behind the same blue whale-hooded child. Child at LEFT foreground with one black-robed acolyte's hand on her near shoulder. The red-haired priest in black and gold stands at RIGHT midground, palm aimed left toward the child. A small amber projectile is already detached from his hand in the open air at RIGHT, travelling left. Leave a clear empty corridor of AIR between child and projectile. A narrow blue water strike approaches from the far LEFT edge across the foreground, aimed at the amber projectile, with the intended collision point visibly to the RIGHT of the child's silhouette, at least one head width away. The child and grip remain readable below/left of the collision point. No beam crosses her body; no impact yet. Keep dark blue stained-glass and warm side candles; no extra caster required in frame.
